rows.rationale: Repeat absent comfort and locate power with oppressors.
rows.before: Again I saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun. And look: the tears of the oppressed, and they have no comforter; power is in the hand of their oppressors, and they have no comforter.
rows.after: I turned again to look at all the oppression under the sun. Look at the tears of the oppressed— no one comforts them. Power lies with their oppressors, and no one comforts them.
rows.tsw_comparator: Again I saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun. And look: the tears of the oppressed, and they have no comforter; power is in the hand of their oppressors, and they have no comforter.

rows.rationale: Retain male kin terms, singular eye read form, and self-question.
rows.before: There is one person, and no second; they have neither son nor brother, yet there is no end to all their toil, and their eyes are never satisfied with wealth. “For whom, then, am I toiling and depriving myself of good?” This too is vapor and an evil task.
rows.after: a man alone, with no companion, without son or brother. There is no end to his work, yet his eye is never satisfied with wealth. “For whom am I working, denying myself enjoyment?” This too is breath—a miserable task.
